story.title: AI's top startups are barely publishing their research

draft:
I've noticed a trend where top AI startups are prioritizing product development over publishing research. 
This shift is concerning, as it limits the ability of others to build upon and improve their work. 
Key findings include:
* Limited transparency into AI decision-making
* Reduced collaboration between industry and academia
What impact do you think this will have on the advancement of AI? 
#AIresearch #techethics #innovation
